facts.text: iCubReach-v0 is registered with entry point pybullet_robot_envs.envs:iCubReachGymEnv, max_episode_steps=1000, IK position control of the left arm (use_IK=1, control_orientation=0) and rendering on by default
The observation concatenates the robot observation, the world observation and the object pose in the hand frame as position and Euler angles
The robot observation is the end-effector position, Euler orientation, Cartesian linear velocity and the positions of the controlled joints
The world observation is the object position and its Euler orientation, or its quaternion when control_eu_or_quat is 1
The controlled joints are the three torso joints plus the seven joints of the selected arm
With use_IK set and control_orientation 0 the action dimension is 3: position x, y and z
The action space is a Box whose every element is bounded by -1 and 1
In IK position mode a raw action element is multiplied by 0.005 and added to the hand position, then the position is clamped to the workspace
The workspace limits are [0.1, 0.45] on x, [-0.3, 0.3] on y and [0.5, 1.0] on z before the table height adjusts the z minimum
Observations and actions are rescaled between the Box bounds and -1..1 by scale_gym_data
The gravity used by the simulation is -9.8 m/s^2 on z
A reset reloads the robot and the world, steps the simulation 100 times after each reload and clears the step counter
The reach task's target distance threshold is 0.03 m
The episode ends when the hand-to-object distance is at most the target distance, when the terminated flag is set, or when the step counter exceeds max_steps
The reward is minus the hand-to-object distance, plus 1000 and (100 - distance * 80) when the distance is at most the target distance
step returns the four-tuple observation, reward, done, info of the legacy Gym API
seed sets the numpy generator and the world and robot seeds and returns the seed in a list

determinism.notes: the environment seeds its numpy generator and its world and robot seeds; the fake draws its start jitter with Python's random.Random(seed), so a seed repeats this package's fake but does not reproduce the upstream trajectory

gaps: rigid-body dynamics of the iCub, the table and the object in PyBullet: contacts, friction and the actuator/sensor models are those of the upstream simulation and are not modelled by this package
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, ticks advance simulated time by timestep_ms only
the upstream registered environment asks for rendering (renders=True); the fake does not render

the fake returns a 31-element observation with the upstream shape but fills the orientation, velocity, joint, object orientation and relative orientation channels with zeros; it was never compared with the upstream environment
no physical device is modelled and the model was never validated against one
snapshot and restore are not offered: the environment exposes no get_state or set_state

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
